description: ams-icdd-usecases: Use cases for employing ICDD containers for infrastructure asset management is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Philipp Hagedorn, Liu Liu (Ruhr University Bochum). This repository provides two use cases for infrastructure asset management using information containers according to the Information Container for linked Document Delivery standard (ISO 25197). Use Case 1 demonstrates the data preparation and result collection of bridge visual inspection with requirement- and delivery container. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
